records.title: ERSTE001
records.department: 独立产品设计 / 建模 / 打样
records.abstract: 从个人 FPS 握持习惯出发，探索形态、人体工学与结构之间的关系。ERSTE001 从想要使用的鼠标，逐步发展成涵盖建模、硬件装配和实体打样的独立产品开发项目。
findings: 人体工学：后背支撑、捏持轴线、按键引导槽与滚轮高度。
结构：Sensor Spine 建立上壳、PCB 与传感器的装配基准。
实现：通过 3D 打印和实物装配检查零件配合。

records.title: 设计路径
records.department: 独立产品设计 / 建模 / 打样
records.abstract: 形态源于握持。围绕实际操控习惯展开外形，再在低矮壳体的空间限制中重新组织内部结构。
findings: 动机 → 人体工学 → 结构问题 → Sensor Spine → 原型。
在案例页查看侧视、俯视、剖面和装配图。
设计与装配过程由 albert_z0413@hotmail.com 独立完成。

records.title: ERSTE002
records.department: 独立产品设计 / 建模 / 打样
records.abstract: ERSTE002 围绕右手人体工学与结构强化展开设计。食指侧较高、中指侧较低的非对称曲面延续至掌心，意在顺应右手及手腕的自然倾斜。无传统底壳、无独立中央龙骨的结构，以一体式特殊加强筋和横向支撑组织壳体内部。约 33 g 为设计目标，尚非实测重量。
findings: 右手人体工学以食指高、中指低为起点，将横向高度差延续至上盖和掌心支撑区域。
结构强化采用一体式特殊加强筋、类工字形截面及横向支撑，连接上盖与侧壁。
约 33 g 为待验证的轻量化目标；主板、电池等电子件为装配展示参考模型。
records.abstractEn: ERSTE002 explores right-hand ergonomics and structural reinforcement. An asymmetric surface, higher beneath the index finger and lower beneath the middle finger, extends into the palm region to follow the natural tilt of the right hand and wrist. With no conventional bottom shell or separate central spine, the design uses integral reinforcement ribs and transverse supports within the shell. Approximately 33 g is a design target, not a measured weight.
findingsEn: Right-hand ergonomics begins with a higher index-finger position and a lower middle-finger position, extending the lateral height difference into the upper shell and palm support region.
Structural reinforcement uses integral ribs, I-like cross-sections and transverse supports to connect the upper shell and sidewalls.
Approximately 33 g remains an unverified lightweight design target. The mainboard, battery and other electronic components are reference models for the assembly presentation.

records.title: 三维结构档案
records.department: 独立产品设计 / 建模 / 打样
records.abstract: 三维结构档案用于阅读零件之间的空间关系。开放式底部与完整爆炸展示装配层次，侧向实体剖切揭示上盖内部类工字形加强筋，按键盖独立翻转展示内侧筋位。电子件仅用于表达装配占位与相对位置。
findings: 无传统底壳的开放式底部保留内部结构的可见性；爆炸状态用于辨认分件和装配关系。
实体剖切观察截面厚度、筋板与侧壁连接；按键盖内侧特写观察交叉筋和薄壁连接。
主板、电池等电子件为参考模型，不能据此确认最终硬件规格、装配公差或整机重量。
records.abstractEn: This 3D record explains spatial relationships between parts. The open underside and full exploded assembly show assembly layers. A lateral solid-section cut reveals I-like reinforcement ribs inside the upper shell, while an independently flipped button cover exposes its internal ribs. Electronic components serve only as references for occupied space and relative placement.
findingsEn: The open underside has no conventional bottom shell and leaves internal structures visible. The exploded state clarifies part divisions and assembly relationships.
Solid-section views show section thickness and rib-to-sidewall connections. Interior button-cover close-ups show cross ribs and their thin-wall connections.
The mainboard, battery and other electronics are reference models. They do not establish final hardware specifications, assembly tolerances or total product weight.

records.title: Sensor Spine
records.department: 独立产品设计 / 建模 / 打样
records.abstract: 以内部脊柱为结构基准，连接上壳、PCB 和传感器系统。将关键支撑集中在核心装配区域，为底壳减重留下空间。
findings: PCB 与上壳建立直接装配关系。
核心区域进行局部加强。
底壳保留关键固定点与必要的支撑路径。

records.title: 非对称曲面与支撑路径
records.department: 独立产品设计 / 建模 / 打样
records.abstract: 设计研究关注外部曲面与内部支撑如何共同组织。食指侧较高、中指侧较低的几何关系贯穿按键、上盖与掌心区域；内部筋板、类工字形截面及横向支撑连接上盖和侧壁，意在为无传统底壳、无独立中央龙骨的壳体提供支撑。
findings: 人体工学研究对象是右手及手腕的自然倾斜，几何表达为食指高、中指低及其向掌心区域的连续过渡。
结构研究对象是筋板、上盖、侧壁与横向支撑之间的连接关系，而非独立中央龙骨。
曲面与支撑布局属于设计意图；现有档案不构成人体工学实验、有限元仿真或刚度提升的验证结论。
records.abstractEn: The design research considers how outer surfaces and internal supports are organized together. The higher index-finger side and lower middle-finger side continue through the buttons, upper shell and palm region. Internal ribs, I-like cross-sections and transverse supports connect the upper shell and sidewalls, intended to support a shell without a conventional bottom shell or separate central spine.
findingsEn: The ergonomic study addresses the natural tilt of the right hand and wrist, expressed as a higher index-finger side, a lower middle-finger side and a continuous transition toward the palm region.
The structural study addresses connections among ribs, the upper shell, sidewalls and transverse supports, rather than a separate central spine.
Surface and support layouts express design intent. This record does not establish results from ergonomic experiments, finite element analysis or stiffness-improvement testing.

records.title: 从 CAD 到实物
records.department: 独立产品设计 / 建模 / 打样
records.abstract: 通过 3D 打印将 CAD 模型变成真实组件，再结合 PCB、传感器、微动与编码器完成实物装配。
findings: 检查外壳、接口和零件配合。
验证螺丝位置及结构连接。
用实际装配检查组装和维护顺序。

records.title: 版本演进与验证边界
records.department: 独立产品设计 / 建模 / 打样
records.abstract: ERSTE002 的早期档案曾以低矮壳体内的空间重排和封闭底板为研究内容。当前正式展示采用无传统底壳、无独立中央龙骨的版本，叙事重点转向右手非对称曲面与一体式结构强化。早期版本记录不代表当前结构。
findings: 早期版本的封闭底板与空间重排属于历史迭代，不能作为当前模型的结构说明。
当前版本以无底壳结构、一体式特殊加强筋和横向支撑为展示基线。
约 33 g 仍为设计目标；实体重量、结构表现与最终硬件配合需以对应版本的后续实物验证为准。
records.abstractEn: Early ERSTE002 records studied space rearrangement within a low-profile shell and a closed base plate. The current portfolio presents a version with no conventional bottom shell or separate central spine, focusing on right-hand asymmetric surfaces and integral structural reinforcement. Early-version records do not describe the current structure.
findingsEn: The closed base plate and space rearrangement belong to earlier iterations and must not be used to describe the current model.
The current presentation baseline is a structure without a conventional bottom shell, using integral reinforcement ribs and transverse supports.
Approximately 33 g remains a design target. Physical weight, structural performance and final hardware fit require subsequent physical validation of the corresponding version.

records.abstract: 本索引汇集 ERSTE 系列项目及联系入口。ERSTE001 展示已完成的设计与原型过程；ERSTE002 以右手人体工学和结构强化为核心，通过外观、右手人体工学、结构与装配、结构强化四章展示当前设计。
findings: ERSTE001：FPS 游戏鼠标设计与实体原型。
ERSTE002：右手非对称曲面、开放式底部与特殊加强筋；约 33 g 为设计目标，电子件为装配参考模型。
联系邮箱：albert_z0413@hotmail.com
records.abstractEn: This index brings together the ERSTE projects and contact information. ERSTE001 presents its completed design and prototyping process. ERSTE002 focuses on right-hand ergonomics and structural reinforcement through four chapters covering appearance, right-hand ergonomics, structure and assembly, and structural reinforcement.
findingsEn: ERSTE001 — FPS gaming mouse design and physical prototype.
ERSTE002 — right-hand asymmetric surfaces, an open underside and special reinforcement ribs. Approximately 33 g is a design target; electronics are assembly reference models.
